news.headline: Rubio: no decision yet on resuming strikes on Iran
news.summary: The Secretary of State said the president has not decided whether to restart strikes; further attacks look unlikely before the US midterms.

news.headline: Araghchi says a mediated proposal could reopen Hormuz within two days
news.summary: Iranian negotiators are talking to Qatari mediators in Doha; Tehran says it has no immediate plan to meet US officials directly. An earlier Iranian offer tied to lifting the port blockade was rejected by Washington.

news.headline: Qatar reports a breakthrough in talks with Iran
news.summary: Doha signalled progress in its mediation between Iran and the US.

news.headline: Khamenei warns renewed US attack would meet a response with no geographic limits
news.summary: Iran's supreme leader issued the warning as Washington weighs further strikes.

news.headline: Hormuz enters day 245 of effective closure
news.summary: The latest published count shows 2 transits on 25 Oct against a normal of about 85 a day.

news.headline: Tanker hit by projectiles off Saudi coast; US carrier groups head to region
news.summary: Two unidentified projectiles struck a crude tanker about 72 nautical miles east of Ras Al Khafji. The USS Theodore Roosevelt and USS Makin Island groups are moving to the Middle East.

news.headline: Russian bombs hit school shelter in Zaporizhzhia; Kharkiv medical site struck
news.summary: At least 24 people were killed when aerial bombs hit a school used as an aid centre; a missile strike on a Kharkiv medical facility injured 62 the next day.

news.headline: US carries out limited strikes on Iran's Qeshm Island
news.summary: US officials say the strikes in the Strait of Hormuz answered IRGC fire on a US aircraft; Iranian state media reported several explosions. Trump says escalation has "no rush" but named the Pickaxe nuclear site as a possible target.

news.headline: Oil posts its biggest drop since July on US–Iran peace hopes
news.summary: Brent fell about 7% to near $105.60 and WTI to about $96.90 as both sides signalled room for diplomacy.

news.headline: IRGC says three tankers exploded after hitting mines in Hormuz
news.summary: The IRGC Navy says the tankers took 'unauthorised' routes with transponders off and were left burning near the strait's southern shore; there is no independent confirmation and no ships were named.

news.headline: Qatari mediators fly to Tehran as Trump says a deal "could happen"
news.summary: Doha talks ended without a breakthrough, but a draft circulated for eight days is now being discussed in Tehran. Vance says there has been progress; the sticking point is whether sanctions relief or nuclear issues come first.

news.headline: Israel asks Lebanon to keep Hezbollah out of any renewed Iran war
news.summary: Through US mediators, Israel reportedly asked Beirut to set up army roadblocks in Hezbollah areas and warned fighting in Lebanon will flare again if Hezbollah attacks.

news.headline: Sudan accuses Ethiopia of hosting RSF drone launches
news.summary: Khartoum says 28 RSF drone attacks using 97 drones came from Ethiopian territory in October alone and has complained to the UN and African Union; Ethiopia denies it.

news.headline: Ukrainian strike reported on Yaroslavl refinery
news.summary: Multiple fires reported at a facility Ukraine has targeted before; Zelensky also confirmed a retaliatory hack of Russian alert systems.

news.headline: Houthis advance to within about 50 miles of Aden
news.summary: The push threatens the temporary seat of Yemen's recognised government; the Houthis also claim drone attacks on Dammam airport and a Jizan radar site, unconfirmed by Riyadh.

news.headline: Aid-site strike death toll hits 29 as Russia launches mass overnight barrage
news.summary: Bombs on an aid centre in Komyshuvakha, Zaporizhzhia, killed at least 29 with 48 missing; Russia then fired 289 drones and 76 missiles at nine regions, forcing emergency power cuts.

news.headline: Next US–Russia–Ukraine peace talks set for 10 Nov in Abu Dhabi
news.summary: US envoy Steve Witkoff announced the date and venue for the next trilateral round.

news.headline: Yemen's government reshuffles cabinet as Houthis close on Aden
news.summary: Three new ministers were named, including a new information minister, as Houthi forces fight about 80 km from Aden.

news.headline: IRGC says it downed US drones near Qeshm; army chief sets five conditions
news.summary: The IRGC claims it downed two MQM-170 drones and an MQ-9 near Hormuz, while armed forces chief Abdollahi demanded full sanctions relief, reparations and recognition of Iranian sovereignty over the strait.

news.headline: Trump says US will stop paying Israel's $4bn annual aid after 2026
news.summary: Speaking as midterm voting began, Trump said he and Netanyahu agreed months ago to end the payments, though the US would still help Israel if needed.

news.headline: Brent slides to about $101 after early jump on Qeshm strikes
news.summary: Oil gave up gains above $107 after Trump's Israel-aid remarks; US Energy Secretary Wright said the Qeshm strikes had not affected oil flows.

news.headline: Iran calls US response 'not convincing' as Qatar-brokered talks stall
news.summary: Security chief Mohsen Rezaei said Hormuz will reopen only if Iran's seven conditions are fully addressed; Qatar says both sides are still reviewing its proposal.

news.headline: Russian barrage knocks three of DTEK's five thermal plants offline
news.summary: Strikes from Odesa to Rivne cut power in Kyiv and at least six regions; Merz backed the Abu Dhabi talks but said Russia shows no sign of serious negotiation.

news.headline: Brent settles at $103.60, lowest close since 7 Oct
news.summary: Oil fell for a second day as Qatar's US–Iran mediation and planned Russia–Ukraine talks raised hopes for more supply; WTI settled at $96.09.

news.headline: Kabila-led rebel coalition including M23 threatens to quit Doha peace talks
news.summary: After meeting MONUSCO chief James Swan in Goma, the FRN said it may walk out if Kinshasa holds a referendum to amend the constitution, which it says could let Tshisekedi seek a third term; local sources report intensifying fighting.

news.headline: North Korea tests cluster-warhead cruise missiles; Kim Yo Jong warns US
news.summary: After the 2 Nov cruise missile test, Kim Yo Jong rejected FBI claims of a $6B Binance theft and warned of a stronger response to US 'hostility'.

news.headline: IRGC says four tankers destroyed by mines south of Hormuz, two vessels detained
news.summary: The Guards say the tankers were still burning in a zone Iran has declared off-limits; no vessels, flags or casualties were named and the claim is unconfirmed.

news.headline: North Korea fires multiple missiles toward the Sea of Japan
news.summary: South Korea's Joint Chiefs said the missiles were launched from the Sondok area, Pyongyang's fourth weapons launch in a month, as Kim Yo Jong ruled out talks with Washington.

news.headline: Iran says Indian, Chinese, Iraqi and Qatari ships may transit Hormuz
news.summary: An Iranian parliamentary security official said the four countries' vessels face no transit restrictions, with Indian and Chinese ships paying a fee to Iran's self-declared strait authority.

news.headline: Democrats win control of Congress; Iran says US voters rejected war
news.summary: Democrats took both chambers in the 3 Nov midterms; Ghalibaf said Americans 'said NO TO WAR', while Trump called the latest Qeshm strike 'minor' and said no major new attack is planned for now.

news.headline: Brent slips to about $102 as gold jumps back above $4,000
news.summary: Oil eased after Trump said he has no immediate plans for new Iran strikes, while gold rose more than 2% on a softer dollar after the Democratic midterm sweep.

news.headline: 310 Russian drones hit energy sites in nine regions; Kyiv says nuclear-plant link targeted
news.summary: Ukraine downed 272 of 310 drones overnight; Shmyhal said three were aimed at a substation vital to the Khmelnytskyi nuclear plant, and Zhytomyr was left largely without power.

news.headline: Trump says US 'must do something large' against Iran, floats a 'heavy hit'
news.summary: The WSJ reports Trump leans toward a large attack but has not decided; Mojtaba Khamenei warned the war would widen if US attacks resume, while Pezeshkian said Iran still seeks dialogue.

news.headline: Houthis claim ballistic-missile strike on Riyadh's King Khalid airport
news.summary: Houthi spokesman Yahya Saree claimed 'significant damage' and told airlines to avoid Saudi airspace outside Mecca and Medina; Saudi authorities have not confirmed an attack.

news.headline: Brent sinks toward $100, a four-week low, on US–Iran deal bets
news.summary: Oil fell for a third session as traders discounted Trump's strike threats and the IRGC mine claims; JPMorgan put October's global surplus at 1.4 million barrels a day.

news.headline: Komyshuvakha aid-site toll rises to 40; allies meet in Brussels on postwar security
news.summary: Zelensky said up to 30 more may be buried; Russian strikes cut power and water in Kyiv for hours, as US, European, NATO and EU officials discussed security guarantees and reconstruction.

news.headline: Israeli drone strike kills man in south Lebanon, first such death since September
news.summary: Lebanon's health ministry said a motorcyclist was killed near Qabrikha; Israel said it hit two suspects watching its troops, as the June disarmament framework lags.

news.headline: Oil crashes nearly 9%: Brent settles at $94.62, lowest since early September
news.summary: WTI settled at $88.12 as traders bet the Democratic sweep of Congress will force an end to the Iran war; benchmarks are down more than 15% this week, and Wall Street had its best day since April 2025.

news.headline: Ukraine, US, Europe and NATO coordinate in Brussels ahead of 10–11 Nov Abu Dhabi talks
news.summary: The European Commission-hosted meeting refined post-war reconstruction scenarios with no concrete outcome reported; Moscow still rejects a full ceasefire and demands Donbas.

news.headline: US sanctions India-run fake ship-registry network serving Iran's shadow fleet
news.summary: OFAC designated 13 people and firms led by Suniel Kumar Sharma, including an 'Eswatini' maritime registry, plus an Istanbul ground-handling firm serving sanctioned Iranian airlines, and warned shippers about fraudulent flags.

news.headline: Trump calls Vance's claim that the Iran war cost the midterms 'largely true' but says he'd do it again
news.summary: Vance said the reason Republicans lost is 'obvious'; Trump defended the war as the only long-term answer to an Iranian bomb, while an AP poll found about 6 in 10 voters call it the wrong decision.

news.headline: Tanker hit by two projectiles north of Qatar, UKMTO says
news.summary: UKMTO reported a tanker struck by two unidentified projectiles about 50 nautical miles north of Madinat ash Shamal, Qatar; crew condition and damage are unconfirmed and no attacker has been named.

news.headline: IRGC says two tankers and a tugboat caught fire in Hormuz on an 'unauthorised route'
news.summary: The Revolutionary Guard said one tanker hit mines, another caught fire leaving the strait and a tug burned while assisting, and blamed the US for encouraging the route; Fars says the Guard also seized two US LUCAS drones. The claims are not independently confirmed.

news.headline: Ukraine and Russia trade mass drone strikes; Komyshuvakha toll reaches 43
news.summary: Russia says it downed 496 Ukrainian drones, with a fire reported at the Ryazan refinery, while Ukraine says it stopped 105 of 128 Russian drones; Zelensky put the aid-site death toll at 43 as Brussels talks on postwar security entered a second day.

news.headline: Saudi-led coalition intercepts Houthi missile over Medina region
news.summary: The coalition said it destroyed a ballistic missile heading toward the Medina region after a danger warning near the port of Yanbu; the Houthis denied targeting Medina and said they aimed at oil facilities and military bases.

news.headline: Trump weighs strikes, a deal or more pressure as US forces prepare for possible major combat
news.summary: Axios reports the military is completing preparations for a return to major combat though no order has been given; Vance favours a deal, and Qatari mediators are pushing a draft that could restart direct talks within days if both sides accept it.

news.headline: Ethiopia and Sudan close each other's border consulates
news.summary: Ethiopia shut Sudan's consulate in Asosa and gave six staff 48 hours to leave, and Sudan ordered Ethiopia's Gedaref consulate closed, amid claims that Ethiopia hosts RSF drone launches.

news.headline: Brent rebounds about 2% to near $97; gold hits a two-week high
news.summary: Oil posted its first gain in four sessions after the IRGC tanker-fire claims, while gold rose toward $4,134 on US–Iran peace hopes and a weaker dollar.

news.headline: Sudanese army retakes two areas south of El-Obeid from the RSF
news.summary: Military sources say the army recaptured Kazgeil and Abu Qaoud, about 45 km south of the North Kordofan capital on a supply route to South Kordofan, after fierce fighting.

news.headline: Machado backs US election roadmap for Venezuela
news.summary: The opposition leader endorsed a State Department plan to renew the top court and electoral council and have interim leader Delcy Rodríguez call elections within six months.

news.headline: US sanctions network supplying Iran with Chinese shoulder-fired missiles
news.summary: The State Department targeted intermediaries in Belarus, Russia and Nigeria accused of helping Iran buy hundreds of Chinese MANPADS air-defence weapons.

news.headline: Brent jumps 3.9% to settle at $98.29 after tanker attacks
news.summary: Oil rebounded from its lowest close since 31 August as at least five vessel incidents since Sunday and Iran's unchanged negotiating stance revived supply fears; WTI settled at $90.52.

news.headline: FT: Russia agreed to supply Iran with 90 helicopter missile launchers
news.summary: Leaked Russian defence documents show an export order for 90 APU-L launchers for Mi-28 attack helicopters for a buyer the FT identifies as Iran, as Tehran seeks Moscow's backing after the US midterms.

news.headline: Iran sends US a nuclear proposal via Qatar but sets seven preconditions
news.summary: A senior Iranian official told Reuters the proposal will be discussed only after Washington meets seven demands, including lifting sanctions, releasing frozen assets and paying war reparations; the US is said to be reviewing it.

news.headline: Trump says he may have to 'destroy' the rest of Iran, with a decision 'soon'
news.summary: Speaking at the White House, Trump said he would 'rather not destroy the rest of the country if possible, but maybe I'll have to', estimated Iran would need 25 years to rebuild, and said 'you'll know soon enough'.

news.headline: Oil extends rebound in Asia on tanker attacks but heads for a steep weekly loss
news.summary: WTI rose 0.7% to $91.14 early on 6 Nov as UKMTO counted at least five vessel incidents since Sunday, but Brent was still set for a weekly drop of more than 15% on bets the midterms speed diplomacy.

news.headline: Iran says five tankers and a tug caught fire near Hormuz
news.summary: The IRGC and Iran's army said in separate statements that tankers struck mines or caught fire on 'illegal' routes near the strait, and a tug fighting one fire also burned; maritime officials have not confirmed the incidents.

news.headline: Trump meets Russian envoy Dmitriev, predicts a 'big agreement' beyond Ukraine
news.summary: Trump met Kirill Dmitriev in Washington on 5 Nov without disclosing what was discussed, ahead of US–Russia–Ukraine talks set for 10–11 Nov in Abu Dhabi.

news.headline: Russia launches 227 drones at Ukraine overnight into 6 Nov
news.summary: Ukraine's air force said 196 were shot down or jammed by morning, with hits at 14 locations and about 15 drones still in the air.

news.headline: European gas extends rebound above €92 but heads for first weekly fall in six weeks
news.summary: TTF rose on Hormuz-related LNG disruption and EU storage near 74%, while Brent hovered just under $100 and gold slipped toward $4,040.

timeline.detail: Trump first says no major attack is planned, then floats a 'heavy hit'; Iran exempts Indian, Chinese, Iraqi and Qatari ships from Hormuz limits and the IRGC claims four tankers mined.
timeline.title: Democrats win Congress; Iran hails a vote 'against war'

timeline.detail: UKMTO reports a tanker hit by projectiles north of Qatar; Trump weighs strikes, a deal or more pressure as US forces reportedly prepare for possible major combat. Iran sends a nuclear proposal via Qatar with seven preconditions, and the FT reports a Russian deal to supply Iran with 90 missile launchers.
timeline.title: IRGC says two tankers and a tug ablaze in Hormuz

timeline.detail: Says a decision on escalation will come soon; Iranian forces claim five tankers and a tug ablaze near Hormuz, unconfirmed.
timeline.title: Trump says he may have to 'destroy' the rest of Iran

timeline.detail: First time since 2022, driven by the Gulf supply shock.
timeline.title: EU gas crosses €100/MWh

timeline.detail: Iran's first limpet-mine attack on a tanker since 2019 is also reported this week.
timeline.title: IRGC reports tankers burning in Hormuz

timeline.detail: Oil drops more than 3%; Saudi Arabia condemns an attack on a Qatari LNG carrier.
timeline.title: Trump signals more time for diplomacy

timeline.detail: Araghchi says the strait could reopen within two days under a mediated proposal; Qatar reports a breakthrough; Khamenei warns against renewed attacks.
timeline.title: Doha talks; Hormuz reopening offer

timeline.detail: Strikes answered IRGC fire on a US aircraft. Doha talks end without a breakthrough; Qatari mediators carry the draft to Tehran.
timeline.title: Limited US strikes on Qeshm Island; mediators go to Tehran

timeline.detail: About 1,300 Palestinians displaced; Jordan retaliates for a church attack.
timeline.title: Hebron displacement; Jordan strikes in Syria

timeline.detail: Prompts appeals to the Vatican.
timeline.title: Israeli strike on church in Lebanon

timeline.detail: About $4bn a year; Houthis reported within ~50 miles of Aden.
timeline.title: Trump says US aid to Israel ends after 2026

timeline.detail: US Embassy in Riyadh warns of attacks near Saudi airports.
timeline.title: Houthi missile damages Aden airport

timeline.detail: Over 100 ballistic missiles fired at the Kyiv region from this date, per Zelenskyy.
timeline.title: Ballistic campaign on Kyiv intensifies

timeline.detail: Both sides confirmed readiness for aid and evacuation; WSJ reports Ukraine informally paused refinery strikes.
timeline.title: Oleshky demining complete; local truce starts

timeline.detail: 289 drones and 76 missiles knock three of DTEK's five thermal plants offline and cut power in Kyiv and six other regions.
timeline.title: Mass strike knocks out DTEK power plants

timeline.detail: Kyiv says three drones targeted a substation serving the Khmelnytskyi nuclear plant; the IAEA was informed.
timeline.title: 310-drone attack hits energy sites in nine regions

timeline.detail: Trump predicts a 'big agreement' involving more than Ukraine ahead of 10–11 Nov Abu Dhabi talks.
timeline.title: Trump meets Russian envoy Dmitriev in Washington

timeline.detail: Up to 350,000 lose power around Dnipro; Russia says 37 drones aimed at Moscow downed since midnight.
timeline.title: Strikes on Kyiv and Dnipro; Moscow drone attack

timeline.detail: Major drone attack on a Samara refinery; US Embassy in Moscow warns of a mass-casualty threat.
timeline.title: Ukraine resumes refinery strikes

timeline.detail: Kremlin says Europeans may only observe in Abu Dhabi; Trump suggests talks may not be in person.
timeline.title: Talks format in question

timeline.detail: Witkoff sets technical talks for 10–11 Nov; bombs on a Komyshuvakha aid site kill at least 29 and a mass overnight barrage forces power cuts.
timeline.title: Abu Dhabi talks scheduled for 10 Nov

chokepoints.detail: Houthi attacks continue to deter traffic; most container lines route Asia–Europe services around the Cape of Good Hope, though some Red Sea services have resumed.
chokepoints.name: Bab el-Mandeb
chokepoints.share: Up: Saudi crude rerouted by pipeline to Yanbu on the Red Sea

chokepoints.detail: Commercial traffic moving, but a sea drone struck a container ship off Bulgaria and Odesa port facilities are under Russian attack.
chokepoints.name: Bosporus & Black Sea lanes
chokepoints.share: Turkish Straits; Caspian and Russian Black Sea crude

chokepoints.detail: Open, carrying diverted Asia–Europe container traffic that would normally use the Red Sea.
chokepoints.name: Cape of Good Hope
chokepoints.share: Not a chokepoint; carries diverted traffic

chokepoints.detail: Open. Elevated NATO presence around undersea cables and Russian naval movements. Live Baltic AIS vessel positions are shown on the globe.
chokepoints.name: Danish Straits (Baltic exit)
chokepoints.share: Main outlet for Russian Baltic crude

chokepoints.detail: Effectively closed to most commercial shipping; Iran's security chief says it will not reopen until seven US conditions are met, though Indian, Chinese, Iraqi and Qatari ships may pass. Iran's IRGC and army say five tankers and a tug caught fire near the strait on 5 Nov, which maritime officials have not confirmed.
chokepoints.name: Strait of Hormuz
chokepoints.share: 26% of seaborne oil and ~20% of LNG before the war
chokepoints.transits: hormuz.now AIS count: 7 vessels on 4 Nov; 7-day average 8.6/day vs ~85/day normal (≈10%)

chokepoints.detail: No disruption reported in this briefing; carries a large share of Gulf crude bound for Asia, now sharply reduced by the Hormuz closure.
chokepoints.name: Strait of Malacca
chokepoints.share: 29% of seaborne oil before the war; down with lost Gulf supply

chokepoints.detail: No disruption reported in this briefing.
chokepoints.name: Panama Canal
chokepoints.share: Up as US crude and products head to Asia

chokepoints.detail: Volumes remain depressed because of Red Sea diversions; a few carriers have restored Red Sea routings.
chokepoints.name: Suez Canal

chokepoints.detail: Open but subject to PLA drills and coast guard patrols. About $1.3T of China's trade and ~$755B of Japanese, Korean and Philippine trade passes through yearly (2024, CSIS).
chokepoints.name: Taiwan Strait

drivers.how: Hormuz oil flows fell from about 21 to 4.9 million barrels a day. The war premium rises with strike threats and falls on diplomacy: Brent dropped ~7% on 2 Nov on peace-talk signals.
Houthi attacks keep Red Sea tanker routing costly; Saudi crude rerouted to Yanbu now relies on Bab el-Mandeb.
Ukrainian drone strikes on Russian refineries and Western sanctions shift refined-product and crude flows.
Iraqi exports depend on Gulf routes; spillover from a resumed US–Iran war would hit southern output.

markets.name: Brent crude
markets.note: Hovered just under $100 in Asian trade on 6 Nov as tanker attacks continued, but is on track for a weekly loss of more than 11%.

drivers.how: The DRC is a leading copper producer; instability and state export controls on its mining belt affect supply.

markets.name: Copper
markets.note: Extended its slide to about $6.20 as a post-midterm tech selloff hit AI-linked demand expectations.

drivers.how: Ukraine is a top corn exporter through its Black Sea ports.
Shipping attacks near Bulgaria and Odesa raise export costs.

markets.name: Corn (CBOT)
markets.note: Held below $4.40, near a three-month low, on ample US supplies and weak export demand.

drivers.how: Safe-haven demand rises with escalation risk and fades when talks progress.
A Taiwan crisis would be the largest safe-haven shock on the board.

markets.name: Gold
markets.note: Slipped below $4,050 on 6 Nov but is still on track for a weekly gain of more than 4%.

drivers.how: Qatari LNG trapped behind Hormuz forces Asian buyers into the spot market.
Qatar's share of Taiwan's gas imports fell from 33.7% to 10.7% this year, raising its exposure to spot prices.

markets.name: Asian LNG (JKM)
markets.note: Northeast Asian spot LNG eased to $31.80 on 3 Nov on Mideast peace talks, after reaching the low $34s on 30 Oct, a near four-year high.

drivers.how: About a fifth of world LNG, mostly Qatari, normally moves through Hormuz; its closure tightens Europe's winter supply.
The EU ban on Russian LNG takes effect on 1 Jan 2027, and energy sanctions stay until the war ends.

markets.name: European gas (TTF)
markets.note: Extended its rebound above €92 on 6 Nov on Gulf LNG disruption and EU storage near 74%, but is still set for a 9% weekly fall, its first in six weeks.

drivers.how: War-risk premiums around Hormuz and ship-to-ship transfer delays in the Gulf tie up tankers and push rates to records.
Sanctions on Russian shadow-fleet tankers shift crude onto mainstream ships.

markets.name: Supertanker rate (VLCC, Gulf–China)
markets.note: TD3C Gulf–China earnings rose 4.4% in week 44 to about $1.35m a day, near record levels as Hormuz risk ties up tankers.
markets.source: ETI Tanker Market Weekly Outlook (TD3C, week 44)

drivers.how: Houthi attacks keep container lines on the longer Cape of Good Hope route, absorbing ship capacity.
Fuel surcharges and Gulf port disruption add to box rates.
A blockade or large drill would disrupt one of the world's busiest container lanes.

markets.name: Container freight (Drewry WCI)
markets.note: Down 1% on the week to $4,389; most Asia–Europe services still sail around Africa.

drivers.how: Ukraine and Russia are major exporters; strikes on Odesa ports threaten shipments.
Attacks on merchant ships raise insurance costs on the main grain export route.

markets.name: Wheat (CBOT)
markets.note: Down about 12% on the month; Black Sea shipping risk is not pricing in a supply shock yet.

drivers.how: Moves with the Gulf war premium; US crude exports have filled part of the gap left by the Hormuz closure.

markets.name: WTI crude
markets.note: Rose about 1% to near $91.50 in Asian trade on 6 Nov after fresh tanker attacks, but is heading for a weekly loss of about 12%.

measures.title: US weighs lifting sanctions on Russia's sovereign wealth fund

measures.summary: Targets leaders in both the Sudanese army and the RSF.
measures.title: UK sanctions 15 commanders on both sides of Sudan's war

measures.title: US authorizes Russian diesel sales and imports until 7 Apr 2027

measures.summary: Firms in several jurisdictions sanctioned for moving Iranian petroleum; wind-down licences run to 20 Nov.
measures.title: OFAC designates an Iranian shadow-fleet network and nine vessels

measures.summary: A 22nd sanctions package is reportedly in preparation; refined-product export bans were reaffirmed.
measures.title: EU: Russian energy sanctions stay until the war ends

measures.title: Lukoil International licence extended to 21 Nov

measures.title: US sanctions five entities linked to Shanghai Zhisuan over trade-secret theft

measures.summary: Removes a remaining Russian gas route into Europe during a tight winter market.
measures.title: EU ban on Russian LNG takes effect

measures.title: DRC cobalt export quotas: 96,600 t a year for 2026–27

measures.title: Iran eases Hormuz transit limits for Indian, Chinese, Iraqi and Qatari ships

measures.title: OFAC targets fraudulent ship registries used by Iran's shadow fleet

measures.summary: The State Department sanctioned two men based in Belarus and Russia and a Nigerian company for allegedly helping Iran acquire hundreds of Chinese shoulder-fired air-defence missiles.
measures.title: US sanctions network buying Chinese MANPADS for Iran

events.title: Tanker hit by projectiles off Saudi coast

events.title: US strikes on Qeshm Island

events.title: Israeli drone strike in south Lebanon

events.title: Tanker hit north of Qatar

events.title: Iran says tankers and a tug ablaze in Hormuz

events.title: Fire at Ryazan refinery after drone attack

events.title: Woman killed by Israeli gunfire near Khan Yunis
